# Getting help

- **How do I…?** Start with the [README](https://github.com/mojtaba-afraz/doxor.js#readme), which covers
  declarations, queries, transactions, migrations, multiple tabs, errors and SSR. If it does not answer your
  question, [open a question issue](https://github.com/mojtaba-afraz/doxor.js/issues/new?template=question.yml).
- **Something is broken:** [report a bug](https://github.com/mojtaba-afraz/doxor.js/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml)
  with a minimal reproduction.
- **A security issue:** see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

doxor.js is maintained by volunteers in their spare time. There is no paid or private support.
